result.rationale: Patient reports ability to walk four steps immediately after injury and at assessment, no inability to bear weight, mild swelling, localized tenderness only at tip of lateral malleolus without midfoot pain or neurovascular symptoms. These findings align with low-risk ankle sprain criteria from NHS guidance for uncomplicated home management; absence of emergency features (e.g., deformity, numbness, inability to walk) supports self-care pathway.
